name: Child
about: The children of Tenebrae and the plateau (shape 708, spawned from monster eggs, no NPC number; game/npc_dialog.h 'shape'). Their own talk is a string of 'why?' questions ending in a menu with 'Bye!' (black-box: engine run). Virtues topics (feature virtues; PLAN-VIRTUES.md: Humility, the user's request 2026-11-08): playing with them and letting them win; each pays once per game, whichever child it is with. After the mark known_avatar (Devon proclaims the Avatar, devon.json), a child who would refuse ('I don't know you.' ... 'My mommie told me never to talk to strangers.', the CHILD use script's 50% branch) talks instead: the scene avatar_friend replaces those lines (scene 'replace', 'line'; game/npc_dialog.h) with her Humility quest, the lost comb (mark kids_comb, Humility 4); afterwards avatar_hello.

topics.label: Want to play a game?
say: A game? With you? You're too big for games!
...All right. Tag! You're it!

topics.label: Chase the child, and stumble just before you catch up.
say: Ha! You fell over your own big feet! Nobody catches me!
You're fun, for a stranger. Will you come back and play again?
Ha! You fell over your own big feet! Nobody catches me, not even the Avatar!
You're fun, for a hero. Will you come back and play again?

topics.label: Catch the child in three long strides.
say: Hey! That's not fair, your legs are as long as a torax!
I'm not playing any more.

topics.label: What do you like to play?
say: Heroes and monsters! But the big kids always want to be the hero.
Can I be the hero? You can be the troll. You're the right size.

topics.label: Roar like a troll, and fall down defeated.
say: Take that, troll! And that! ...Is it dead? You have to stay dead!
I won! I'm the hero of Tenebrae! Wait till I tell everybody!

topics.label: I am a real hero. I should be the hero.
say: Everybody says that. You're just like the big kids.

topics.label: I have a question for you, too.
say: For me? Nobody asks ME things. What is it?

topics.label: Why ARE toraxes big and brown? I do not know. Will you tell me what you think?
say: You don't know? But you're so old!
I think they're brown so they can hide in the mud, and big so the trolls don't eat them. That's what I think.
...You're the first grown-up who ever said they didn't know something.

topics.label: Explain at length what you know about toraxes.
say: ...Are you finished? I forgot what I asked.
Wait... I know you! You're the Avatar!
Mommy says I mustn't ever talk to strangers. But she says you're not a stranger. You're the Avatar, and the Avatar helped Devon, and the Avatar is everybody's friend.
So I can talk to you. Can I ask you something? It's important.

topics.label: Of course. What is it?
say: Mommy lost her comb. Her best one, with the shell on it, that Grandmother gave her. She cried about it when she thought I was asleep.
I know where it is. I saw the cat take it! But nobody listens to me because I'm little.
You can help. But you have to do it MY way, because I know where it is and you don't.

topics.label: Lead the way. You know this city better than I do.
say: This way! Quiet... don't step there, that's where the cats sleep.
There! Under the big step. See it shining? The cat pushes things in there. She has a whole treasure.
Your hand is too big to fit. Mine isn't. You lift the stone, and I'll reach in.

topics.label: Lift the stone, and let the child reach in.
say: Got it! And a button, and a spoon, and... ew, a fish bone.
Mommy! Mommy, look! I found your comb! ...Well, the Avatar lifted the stone. But I found it.
She's crying again, but it's the good kind. Thank you, Avatar. You're really good at doing what you're told.

topics.label: Reach in yourself. You are faster.
say: Hey! You're stuck! Your hand is stuck! Pull, Avatar, pull!
...Now the cat has scratched you, and the comb went further in. I TOLD you your hand was too big.
I'll get it myself tomorrow. Come back if you want to help properly.

topics.label: Tell me where it is, and I will fetch it for you.
say: No! You don't know the way, and the cats run off with everything when a big person comes. You have to follow ME.
You're just like all the other grown-ups. Come back when you'll do it my way.

topics.label: I have no time for lost combs.
say: Oh.
Mommy was wrong. You ARE a stranger.

topics.label: Bye!
say: Bye, Avatar! I'm going to tell everybody I talked to you!
It's the Avatar! Mommy says hello. She wears her comb every single day now.
The cat's got a new treasure under the step, but I'm not telling you where. Bye, Avatar!
